description: TokenWise: replace the output of recognized Bash commands with a smaller projection (in bypassPermissions mode, run them through `tokenwise run`); after a compaction, add the catalog of tool results TokenWise kept recallable. At startup, say when the tokenwise command is missing, when recorded output is worth learning from, and when a learning run finished.

hooks.command: if command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1; then tokenwise hook claude; else echo '{"systemMessage":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/HKUDS/TokenWise#install"}'; fi
